Light sources.note: 'A light source': lit, portable light sources. Unlit and empty forms left out.

Hatchets.note: 'Any hatchet': the main metal and special hatchets. Dungeoneering and minigame-only ones left out.

Pickaxes.note: 'Any pickaxe': the main metal and special pickaxes. Dungeoneering, gilded and +1 versions left out.

Nails.note: 'Nails of any metal'. A line's own 'except rune nails' clause still drops rune nails there.

Sunglasses.note: Fur 'n Seek: any colour works as an alternative.

Sandstone.note: Enakhra's Lament: any combination of sandstone sizes.

Granite.note: King's Ransom: granite of any size.

Pizza.note: Enakhra's Lament: any whole cooked pizza (partial pizzas don't work).

Pie.note: Enakhra's Lament: any whole cooked pie; mince pie and partial pies don't work.

Flowers.note: Throne of Miscellania: a bunch of flowers from the Flower Girl, any colour.

Blackjacks.note: A Guild of Our Own: any blackjack except the rubber one.

Ghostly robe outfit.note: The full set (both page names for the robe exist on the Wiki).
